node.name: Cosmic_Time_Candy
node.description: Hold down to get anywhere from 5 hours to 500 hours of AFK time! Gives 24 hrs on average. Odds are: 54% for 5-10hr, 25% for 10-25hr, 18% for 25-100 hr, 2.1% for 100-499hr, 0.4% for 500hr.

quest:Carpenter_Cardinal1.name: Restoring_Power,_once_again,_to_a_Portal
quest:Carpenter_Cardinal1.description: Retrieve the Galaxial Amethyst from Chizoar, the World 3 boss.

quest:Rift_Ripper1.name: Entering_The_Rift...
quest:Rift_Ripper1.description: Get these random items to gain access to The Rift.

quest:Nebulyte3.name: Oh_Geez_Lets_Not_Think_About_This_One...
quest:Nebulyte3.description: Defeat 12 million green mushrooms by yourself. Check Monster Card to see your personal killcount.

quest:Royal_Worm7.name: Bossin'_the_Boss
quest:Royal_Worm7.description: Defeat the Troll boss on Nightmare 100 times.

item:Crystal3.name: Galaxial_Amethyst
item:Crystal3.description: Restores power to the Galaxy Portal in the glacier town, allowing travel to World 4!

item:Quest70.name: Phone_Box
item:Quest70.description: IdleOn is out on iOS devices! The Rift Ripper must have kept a few of these back when he played during the iOS Launch event... Hold down to open, and a random reward will drop at your feet!

item:Quest71.name: Gem_Envelope
item:Quest71.description: Contains a random number of gems, hold down to open! It could be just a couple gems, but it could also have as many as 10,000 gems!

item:GalaxyA2b.name: Lost_Batteries
item:GalaxyA2b.description: Oh, THATS why the remote wasn't working when I pushed the buttons, the batteries were all the way out here in the rare drop table!

item:GalaxyA1.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
item:GalaxyA1.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

item:CardPack6.name: Smolderin_Card_Pack
item:CardPack6.description: Hold down to open the pack! The cards drop on the ground, make sure to pick them up!!

item:Pearl6.name: Divinity_Pearl
item:Pearl6.description: Hold down to gain 40% EXP in the current skill you're doing! If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. Only works on skills below level 50. IMPORTANT: This cannot be used for skills in World 5 or beyond.
